label: Qwen-Image-Edit Rapid AIO (edit from up to 3 reference images, 4 steps)

capabilities._note: Image edit with up to 3 reference images (the stock TextEncodeQwenImageEditPlus's image1..image3, on the positive and the negative alike); with none it is text to image. Phr00t's merge of Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 with its accelerator LoRAs: four steps at cfg 1, so the negative prompt is inert and is not offered. Its use is composing: characters from their own pictures put into a plate with their faces kept.

template._note: Sizes a series ref is generated at (as krea2's). An edit or keyframe is generated at its own size, on a 16 grid and scaled up to about 1 MP (the model's training size): EmptySD3LatentImage sets the output, and the encoder scales each reference itself.

recipe._note: The prompt names each reference by its number ('image 1', 'image 2', ...), as the Qwen edit models read them.

binding._note: An API graph written by hand from Phr00t's README (Load Checkpoint -> TextEncodeQwenImageEditPlus -> KSampler, er_sde/beta, 4 steps, cfg 1) and ComfyUI's image_qwen_image_edit_2511.json: the checkpoint gives model, CLIP and VAE; the positive and negative encoders both read the reference images (graph code wires image1..image3 and repeats the 'Reference 1' LoadImage); the output size is the job's EmptySD3LatentImage. No ModelSamplingAuraFlow: the merge carries its own tuning and its author's workflow has none. No LoRA loader: `insert_after` puts one after the checkpoint's MODEL when a job has LoRAs. H3SaveRefTake takes the place of SaveImage.

models._note: One all-in-one checkpoint (model, text encoder and VAE). Name-based identification only. v19 is the author's pick for consistency in edits, v23 for prompt adherence; either matches.

presets._note: Phr00t's settings for v19/v23: 4 steps (4-8 work), cfg 1, er_sde/beta (euler_ancestral/beta also recommended), denoise 1.

downloads._note: Where to get each file this target names (docs/API.md 'Downloads').
